whyNow.heading: The next horizon
whyNow.lead: AI is opening a new creative horizon—raising some of our deepest human questions. Does our contribution still matter? Who gets to decide what comes next? Can we belong to something larger and remain ourselves? Beneath these questions lies a familiar tension: an impulse to hold back change or try to control it.
paragraphs: Imaginal carries these questions into a future of abundance, where uncertainty and the struggle over freedom remain. They unfold through a human lens: a daughter stepping out of her mother’s shadow, a mother entrusting someone else with unfinished work, and a human and an AI learning to create together.

Through these relationships, the film reveals that preserving what matters can mean allowing its form to change. It does not seek to eliminate uncertainty or fight resistance. It invites audiences to recognize their creative agency: to imagine possibilities, bring something of their own to what we create together, and harness progress to expand our sovereignty and capacity to create. Seeing this possibility is the only way to break through the resistance. The film exists to make this possibility felt.
